text:
talia: Heads-up  Visitor arriving tomorrow 10:30am (Ms. Vega) — bringing a folded mobility scooter and two medium sample boxes. Can we arrange accessible drop-off + a temporary parking pass? cc @frontdesk :wheelchair:
frontdesk: We can arrange accessible drop-off. For parking pass please submit the vehicle plate here: https://redwood.example/parking-pass. If scooter folds, we can store it by the concierge. If its unfolded, we'll reserve the accessible spot near entrance.
ops-guard: FYI security needs carrier name + plate for gate access. If vendor needs ramp assistance, we can meet at 10:20.
talia: Carrier is "BlueGate Logistics", plate ZXY-443, contact 555-0311. I'll also add a note on the booking that scooter may arrive unfolded.
ryan: If the boxes are under 5kg front desk can hold them; larger items go to Loading Dock C. Please mark fragile if samples contain glass.
people-ops-bot: Temp badge created: PASS-661 for Ms. Vega (valid 06/12 08:00-18:00). Accessible parking pass requested for plate ZXY-443. Check-in QR: https://redwood.example/checkin/PASS-661.
leah: Quick note  mailroom lockers are at 92% capacity. If you prefer front desk hold, add label "hold-for-talia". Offsite staging available for oversized crates.
cory: I can meet at 10:20 to help with scooter ramp. Reply "can-help" if you can assist moving it from curb to lobby.
leah: can-help
ryan: can-help
frontdesk: We'll print one visitor sticker and keep both temp pass + sticker at desk. If kiosk throws 502 use manual form: https://redwood.example/manual-visitor. We'll radio security when courier arrives.
talia: Thanks! Also small seating request  can we reserve two seats at the east bench for the guest and an associate from 11:00-11:45?
frontdesk: Noted  we'll put a temporary sticky and create a 11:00 calendar block "guest seating: Vega" so people see it.
talia: Last quick thing  samples may include dairy. Anyone allergic to dairy reply "dairy" so we avoid serving it at the debrief.
ryan: dairy
people-ops-bot: Reminder: label any food with owner + date when storing in fridge. Happy to help with logistics questions.
